# has logo

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasLogo`](gmeow-hasLogo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasLogo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The media object that serves as an entity's logo — its emblematic, identity-bearing image. An organization, software project, dataset, place, or product may carry one. Distinct from [`gmeow:depicts`](gmeow-depicts.md): a logo represents the entity rather than picturing it; it is therefore NOT a subproperty of [`gmeow:isAbout`](gmeow-isAbout.md).
